steps: Open public Sohojkor homepage → Pay Tax → Tax with Return → enter and confirm own TIN → select the one assessment year → review amount → make payment → view confirmation and receipt and certificate → later sign in → open Payment History.

module: Other Tax, Advance Tax & Source Tax
journey_name: As a guest, I want to pay several eligible Other Tax heads for different assessm
steps: Homepage → Pay Tax → Other Tax → Walk-in Payment → enter payer/recipient details → add eligible head-and-year lines → review each amount and total → pay → confirmation/combined receipt and certificate → sign in later → Payment History.

journey_name: As a payer, I want to pay another taxpayer’s tax, see the payment in my own hist
steps: Pay for another taxpayer → enter and check B’s TIN → choose allowed payment type/lines → optionally enter and verify A’s separate payer TIN → pay → confirmation and receipt and certificate → A signs in to view payer history → B signs in to view received payment and notice.

journey_name: As a taxpayer with a TIN who has never signed in to Sohojkor, I want the existin
steps: Person has valid TIN but no previous Sohojkor login → other people may pay for that TIN → first demo sign-in → enter demo OTP 111111 → automatically open matching account → show sign-in success → show first unseen payment popup → acknowledge/next → repeat for remaining unseen notices → view full Notifications list.

journey_name: As a guest or signed-in payer, I want Tax with Return to be limited to one taxpa
steps: Pay Tax → Tax with Return → select exactly one taxpayer and one assessment year → review → pay; if extra taxpayer, year or head is added, show the existing relevant validation.

module: Payment history, beneficiary profile and Pay Again
journey_name: As a signed-in payer, I want to select Pay Again on an individual successful pay
steps: Sign in → Payment History → choose a completed row → Pay Again → inspect prefilled entire transaction → edit recipients/heads/years/amounts → review → pay.

journey_name: As a taxpayer, I want to request correction of an eligible payment and receive a
steps: Find owned eligible payment → sign in if needed → Request Correction → enter corrected information/reason → submit → Office review → approve or reject → see decision, date and status in account.

journey_name: As a payer, I want each successfully completed ordinary recorded payment to show
steps: Choose eligible payment → review → complete the existing payment journey → receive success confirmation → view or download receipt.

journey_name: As a signed-in payer, I want to create lists, add beneficiaries and apply the re
steps: Sign in → Beneficiaries → Create List → name list → Add Beneficiary → enter/check TIN → select system tag/relationship → save → see person in list.

journey_name: As a signed-in taxpayer, I want the dashboard to show accurate information about
steps: Sign in → dashboard → view completed payments, saved drafts, corrections and linked activity → open a detail or resume eligible draft.

module: Tax with Return + Other/combined challan forms, original API/SQL and Office transaction details

steps: Pay Tax → select existing valid challan type/beneficiary/head/year/amount → enter optional Remarks → Review → confirm submitted payment → open original challan → see complete remarks; later recover draft or Pay Again editable copy.
